$comment: FUSION model constants (PRD F19). Single source of truth: read by the Python pipeline (pipeline/config.py) and by the React app (F18 methodology panel renders this file verbatim). Every entry carries a `status`: 'source' = traceable to a cited public reference; 'assumption' = a modelling choice made by the team, deliberate but not externally sourced; 'placeholder' = the team has NOT confirmed this value and it must not be presented as authoritative.

h3_resolution.label: Analysis cell resolution
h3_resolution.source: PRD F1. Mean cell area at res 6 is 36.13 km^2 (h3.average_hexagon_area).

weather_h3_resolution.label: Weather sampling resolution
weather_h3_resolution.source: PRD §7.2: weather fields are smooth at tens-of-km scale, so they are sampled on a coarse grid and applied to the cells within each.

w_tree.label: Tree cover weight in fuel load

w_shrub.label: Shrub cover weight in fuel load

w_grass.label: Grass cover weight in fuel load

burnable_threshold.label: Minimum fuel for a cell to be treated as burnable
burnable_threshold.source: PRD §9.1. Cells at or below this are shown as not-applicable (F3), not as low priority.

worldcover_classes.label: Land-cover classes mapped to fuel types
worldcover_classes.source: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200 product user manual, class legend (10 Tree cover, 20 Shrubland, 30 Grassland).

sample_resolution_m.label: Ground sampling distance used to read WorldCover
sample_resolution_m.source: WorldCover overview level 8 (10 m x 8). Reading all of Spain at native 10 m is ~10^10 pixels (PRD §11.6). Overviews were verified to use mode/nearest resampling, so class codes stay valid. Cover fractions are therefore a spatial SAMPLE (~5,600 samples per 36 km^2 cell), not an exhaustive area integral.

broadleaf_share_weight.label: Broadleaf forest share term
broadleaf_share_weight.source: Set to zero. PRD §7.2 records this as a data gap: ESA WorldCover has no leaf-type class and no substitute source was identified. The term is disabled rather than guessed (D1).

w_coef_tmax.label: Weight on daily max temperature anomaly

w_coef_rhmin.label: Weight on (negated) minimum relative humidity anomaly

w_coef_wind.label: Weight on max wind speed anomaly

w_coef_days_since_rain.label: Weight on days-since-rain anomaly
w_coef_days_since_rain.source: PRD §9.2. NOTE (PRD §11.2, open question): days_since_rain feeds W while precipitation also drives the moisture term M, so dryness is partly double-counted. Retained as specified; set this to 0 to test the alternative.

rain_day_threshold_mm.label: Daily precipitation above which a day counts as a rain day
rain_day_threshold_mm.source: Needed to evaluate days_since_rain, which PRD §9.2 names but does not define. 1 mm/day is the conventional wet-day threshold used by WMO-style climate indices.

moisture_window_days.label: Antecedent precipitation window for the moisture proxy

moisture_saturation_mm.label: Antecedent precipitation at which the moisture proxy M reaches 1
moisture_saturation_mm.source: PRD §9.2 defines M only as 'a moisture proxy 0-1 from 30-day antecedent precipitation' and gives no scale. M = clamp(precip_30d / this value, 0, 1). The team has not confirmed this figure.

combustion_floor.label: Combustion multiplier at full moisture
combustion_floor.source: PRD §9.2: COMBUSTION = F x W x (0.4 + 0.6 x (1 - M))

combustion_moisture_span.label: Additional combustion multiplier at zero moisture

exposure_offset.label: Fuel offset in the wildland-exposure fraction

exposure_min.label: Floor on exposed population share
exposure_min.source: PRD §9.3. Keeps dense city cores near zero without making them exactly zero.

pop_normaliser.label: Population scale in the consequence score
pop_normaliser.source: PRD §9.3: pop_exposed / 8000. Sets one consequence point equal to 8,000 exposed residents, which puts population on the same numeric footing as the asset scores below.

neighbour_weight.label: Weight on adjacent cells' exposed population
neighbour_weight.source: PRD §9.3. Applied to the six immediate H3 neighbours (k-ring 1, excluding the cell itself).

asset_class_cap.unit: consequence points per class per cell
asset_class_cap.label: Cap on any single asset class's contribution to one cell
asset_class_cap.source: PRD §9.3 requires that 'each asset class's contribution per cell is capped' but does not give the cap. Set here so that no class can outweigh roughly two hospitals; prevents a cell with many schools or a long motorway run from dominating the ranking. NOT confirmed by the team.

cascade_coefficient.unit: consequence points per person within the radius
cascade_coefficient.label: Cascade term for power assets
cascade_coefficient.source: PRD §9.3. Applied to substations and power plants only: a power asset is scored for the people in the area it sits in. This is a PROXIMITY measure - the model does not trace which people are actually supplied by which asset.

cascade_applies_to.label: Asset classes receiving the cascade term
cascade_applies_to.source: PRD §9.3. PRD §11.3 asks as an open question whether hospitals should also receive it; they currently do not.

cascade_radius_km.label: Radius for the cascade population count
cascade_radius_km.source: PRD §9.3 ('population within ~10 km'). Implemented as the H3 res-6 k-ring that covers this radius.

natura_weight.label: Protected-habitat (Natura 2000) term
natura_weight.source: PRD §9.3 specifies 6 x natura_fraction, but PRD §7.2 lists the Natura 2000 dataset as unverified and possibly login-walled, with 'omit the term, weight 0' as the fallback. The dataset was not obtained, so the term is disabled (D2) rather than estimated. Restore to 6.0 if the layer is added.

natura_weight_if_available.label: Natura 2000 weight specified by the model
natura_weight_if_available.source: PRD §9.3. Recorded for transparency; inactive while the source is unavailable.

strategic_share.label: Share of each cell's burnable area actually treated
strategic_share.source: PRD §9.4 (STRAT). Prevention treats fuel breaks and strategic mosaics, not whole landscapes.

cost_per_ha_eur.source: PRD §9.4. Mid-point (87 EUR/ha) is used for costing; the spread is shown in the methodology panel. Underlying citation not supplied with the brief.

effectiveness.source: PRD §9.4 states effectiveness ranges are NOT YET DEFINED by the team and must ship as labelled placeholders. Illustrative only - do not cite.

national_cap_ha.source: PRD §9.4 notes grazing is capped because shepherds are scarce, but gives no figure. Illustrative only - do not cite.

cost_per_ha_eur.source: PRD §9.4 (~250 EUR/ha). Underlying citation not supplied with the brief.

effectiveness.source: PRD §9.4: not yet defined by the team. Illustrative only - do not cite.

national_cap_ha.source: PRD §9.4 notes burning is capped by suitable weather windows, but gives no figure. Illustrative only - do not cite.

cost_per_ha_eur.source: PRD §9.4 (~1,200 EUR/ha). Underlying citation not supplied with the brief.

effectiveness.source: PRD §9.4: not yet defined by the team. Illustrative only - do not cite.

cost_per_ha_eur.source: PRD §9.4 says only 'high cost' and gives no figure. Illustrative only - do not cite.

effectiveness.source: PRD §9.4: not yet defined by the team. Illustrative only - do not cite.

min_exposed_population.source: PRD §9.4 restricts this instrument to cells where exposed population is 'high' but sets no threshold. Illustrative only - do not cite.

years.source: PRD §9.5: the hotter of 2022 and 2025 summer conditions, selected per weather cell.

effectiveness_case.source: PRD §9.5. 'Mid' is the mean of the worst and best effectiveness values, which are themselves placeholders.

summer_months.label: Months treated as the fire season
summer_months.source: PRD §9.5 refers to 'summer conditions' without defining the window. June-September covers the Spanish fire season.

hectares_per_worker_year.label: Treated area one field worker covers in a year
hectares_per_worker_year.source: Needed for the implied-workforce figure in PRD F12. No source was supplied with the brief and the team has not confirmed it. Illustrative only - do not cite.

boundary.label: Country boundary
boundary.source: https://www.geoboundaries.org/api/current/gbOpen/ESP/ADM0/ - derived from Instituto Geografico Nacional. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Verified reachable 19 Sep 2026.

population.label: Population
population.source: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kontur-population-spain - GeoPackage, no login. Licence: CC BY 4.0 (Kontur, derived from GHSL/Facebook/Microsoft/OSM). Verified reachable 19 Sep 2026.

fuel.label: Fuel / vegetation cover
fuel.source: https://esa-worldcover.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/v200/2021/map/ - public bucket, no login. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Verified reachable and range-readable 19 Sep 2026.

assets.label: Critical assets and place names
assets.source: https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter - requires a descriptive User-Agent. Licence: ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors. Verified reachable 19 Sep 2026.

weather.label: Current and historical weather
weather.used: Open-Meteo forecast API and archive (ERA5) API
weather.source: https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast and https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive - free, no key. Licence: CC BY 4.0; data derived from ERA5 (Copernicus). Variable names temperature_2m_max, relative_humidity_2m_min, wind_speed_10m_max, precipitation_sum confirmed against live responses 19 Sep 2026.

fire_danger_overlay.label: Official fire-danger forecast (F8)
fire_danger_overlay.source: https://maps.effis.emergency.copernicus.eu/effis - SUBSTITUTION (D2): the endpoint given in PRD §7.2 (ies-ows.jrc.ec.europa.eu/effis) returns 'msLoadMap(): Unable to access file' and serves no layers. The Copernicus-hosted EFFIS endpoint was used instead; layer mf010.fwi, EPSG:4326, WMS 1.1.1, time dimension from 2018-01-01. Verified rendering over Spain 19 Sep 2026.

basemap.label: Basemap
basemap.source: https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/dark-matter-gl-style/style.json - token-free. (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, (c) CARTO. Verified reachable 19 Sep 2026. Per C3 the app functions without it.

natura2000.label: Protected habitat
natura2000.source: PRD §7.2 lists this as unverified and possibly login-walled. Not obtained within the time box, so the natura term carries weight 0 (D2).

broadleaf.label: Broadleaf forest share
broadleaf.source: PRD §7.2 records this as a data gap with no identified source. Term weight 0 (D2).
